headline: An Agentic Playbook for Authorized Bug Hunting
lede: Claude-BugHunter packages reconnaissance, validation, reporting, and evidence hygiene into a disciplined security workflow. Its 83 skills and 681 vulnerability-report patterns give authorized testers a structured route from scope to disclosure, with explicit boundaries around offensive use.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Method
lede: Superpowers replaces improvisation with a staged engineering system: clarify the requirement, validate the design, plan the work, then execute in small tested units. Worktrees, subagents, and review checkpoints turn autonomous coding into a repeatable operational process.

headline: CLI-Anything Makes Every App Agent-Ready
lede: CLI-Anything converts desktop software, services, and creative tools into structured command-line harnesses that agents can operate and test. Its CLI-Hub adds a practical distribution layer, making capabilities discoverable, installable, and reusable across workflows.

headline: MiniMind Builds a Language Model from Scratch
lede: MiniMind makes the full language-model pipeline small enough to inspect and affordable enough to run on a consumer GPU. Pretraining, alignment, distillation, reinforcement learning, and serving all remain visible in native PyTorch code.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to Real Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog extends coding agents into engineering, operations, sales, recruiting, and knowledge-work systems. Standard manifests and reusable skills provide a practical integration surface for teams that want automation inside established tools.

headline: Firecrawl Turns the Live Web into Context
lede: Firecrawl handles the messy middle between a live website and an agent-ready document. Rendering, crawling, proxy rotation, extraction, monitoring, and interactive actions flow through one platform, producing Markdown, JSON, HTML, or screenshots for downstream systems.

headline: NGINX Keeps the Edge Moving
lede: NGINX remains a compact engine for serving, proxying, balancing, caching, and protecting traffic at scale. Its worker architecture, modular build system, and plain-text configuration keep performance and operational control close to the metal.

headline: OpenVINO Moves AI Inference Closer to Hardware
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training ecosystems into optimized deployments for CPUs, GPUs, and Intel NPUs. Quantization, serving, and broad language and vision support give production teams a direct path from framework code to efficient inference.

headline: Diagram Design Makes Architecture Renderable
lede: Diagram Design turns a plain-language brief into a polished, standalone HTML and SVG artifact. With 44 diagram types, grid-aware layout checks, and brand-aware palettes, it treats technical communication as a visual system rather than a rough sketch.

headline: Last30Days Maps the Internet’s Recent Memory
lede: Last30days-skill assembles current signals from social platforms, news, research, markets, video, and developer communities into an evidence-grounded brief. Parallel searches and attributable source material create a compact research record for decisions that depend on what changed recently.
